name: Pokémon Top Trumps
source: PokeAPI (https://pokeapi.co) — official base stats, genus, and English Pokédex entries

rules.deal: Shuffle 30 cards. Two players get 15 each; three players get 10 each. Highest chosen stat wins the opponent’s card.
rules.tie: Both cards go to a pile; next winner takes the pile.

notes: 30-card pack of household names, mostly from the original 151, plus Tyranitar and Lucario. Specialists so most categories have a unique champion (Chansey HP, Cloyster Defence, Mewtwo Sp. Attack, Electrode Speed, Onix Height, Snorlax Weight). Attack is a close cluster (Dragonite and Tyranitar 134). Base stats only (no Mega, Gigantamax, or regional forms). Locked look: folklore captions, cinematic type photos, inset type bars.

cards.name: Venusaur
cards.blurb: Its plant blooms when it is absorbing solar energy. It stays on the move to seek sunlight.
cards.caption: A bewitching aroma wafts from its flower. The fragrance becalms those engaged in a battle.

cards.name: Charizard
cards.blurb: It spits fire that is hot enough to melt boulders. It may cause forest fires by blowing flames.
cards.caption: If it becomes furious, the flame at the tip of its tail flares whitish-blue.

cards.name: Blastoise
cards.blurb: It crushes its foe under its heavy body to cause fainting. In a pinch, it will withdraw inside its shell.
cards.caption: It firmly plants its feet on the ground before shooting water from the jets on its back.

cards.name: Pikachu
cards.blurb: Pikachu that can generate powerful electricity have cheek sacs that are extra soft and super stretchy.
cards.caption: It raises its tail to check its surroundings. The tail is sometimes struck by lightning in this pose.

cards.name: Nidoking
cards.blurb: Nidoking prides itself on its strength. It’s forceful and spirited in battle, making use of its thick tail and diamond-crushing horn.
cards.caption: One swing of its mighty tail can snap a telephone pole as if it were a matchstick.

cards.name: Arcanine
cards.blurb: The sight of it running over 6,200 miles in a single day and night has captivated many people.
cards.caption: A Pokémon that is described in Chinese legends. It is said to race at an unbelievable speed.

cards.name: Alakazam
cards.blurb: It has an incredibly high level of intelligence. Some say that Alakazam remembers everything that ever happens to it, from birth till death.
cards.caption: Closing both its eyes heightens all its other senses.

cards.name: Machamp
cards.blurb: It quickly swings its four arms to rock its opponents with ceaseless punches and chops from all angles.
cards.caption: One arm alone can move mountains.

cards.name: Golem
cards.blurb: The rocklike shell is shed each year. The cast-off shell then crumbles, reverting to a mass of soil, which can be spread across fields to promote crop growth.
cards.caption: Its boulder-like body is extremely hard. It can easily withstand dynamite blasts without taking damage.

cards.name: Cloyster
cards.blurb: Once it slams its shell shut, it is impossible to open, even by those with superior strength.
cards.caption: Its shell is extremely hard. It cannot be shattered, even with a bomb. The shell opens only when it is attacking.

cards.name: Gengar
cards.blurb: On the night of a full moon, if shadows move on their own and laugh, it must be Gengar’s doing.
cards.caption: It is said to emerge from darkness to steal the lives of those who become lost in mountains.

cards.name: Onix
cards.blurb: This chain of immense stones resembles a giant serpent. Tremors shake the earth above as it burrows deep beneath the ground, feeding on boulders as it goes.
cards.caption: It twists and squirms through the ground. The thunderous roar of its tunneling echoes a long way.

cards.name: Electrode
cards.blurb: The tissue on the surface of its body is curiously similar in composition to an Apricorn. When irritated, this Pokémon lets loose an electric current equal to 20 lightning bolts.
cards.caption: The more energy it charges up, the faster it gets. But this also makes it more likely to explode.

cards.name: Chansey
cards.blurb: This purehearted Pokémon shares its eggs with the injured.
cards.caption: It is said to deliver happiness. Being compassionate, it shares its eggs with injured people.

cards.name: Scyther
cards.blurb: The large, wickedly sharp scythes on its forearms are truly fearsome weapons. Prey's attempts to flee are unfailingly thwarted by this Pokémon's nimble motions.
cards.caption: It slashes through grass with its sharp scythes, moving too fast for the human eye to track.

cards.name: Gyarados
cards.blurb: It has an extremely aggressive nature. The Hyper Beam it shoots from its mouth totally incinerates all targets.
cards.caption: Brutally vicious and enormously destructive. Known for totally destroying cities in ancient times.

cards.name: Lapras
cards.blurb: A smart and kindhearted Pokémon, it glides across the surface of the sea while its beautiful song echoes around it.
cards.caption: Its high intelligence enables it to understand human speech. It likes to ferry people on its back.

cards.name: Eevee
cards.blurb: Harbors the potential to evolve into manifold forms. Within Eevee lies the key to the mysteries of Pokémon evolution—I'm certain of it.
cards.caption: A rare Pokémon that adapts to harsh environments by taking on different evolutionary forms.

cards.name: Vaporeon
cards.blurb: Tests show that its cells closely resemble water molecules, which perhaps explains its ability to conceal its form while submerged. I believe the origins of mermaid folklore lie with this Pokémon.
cards.caption: Lives close to water. Its long tail is ridged with a fin which is often mistaken for a mermaid’s.

cards.name: Jolteon
cards.blurb: Bristles its fur into sharp, needlelike points when enraged. One can hear electricity crackle in its breath when it exhales.
cards.caption: It accumulates negative ions in the atmosphere to blast out 10,000-volt lightning bolts.

cards.name: Flareon
cards.blurb: Flames burn within a saclike organ inside this Pokémon. When Flareon inhales, these flames grow in intensity, reaching a mighty 3,000 degrees Fahrenheit.
cards.caption: When storing thermal energy in its body, its temperature can soar to over 1,600 degrees Fahrenheit.

cards.name: Aerodactyl
cards.blurb: Aerodactyl’s sawlike fangs can shred skin to tatters—even the skin of Steel-type Pokémon.
cards.caption: In prehistoric times, this Pokémon flew freely and fearlessly through the skies.

cards.name: Snorlax
cards.blurb: It is not satisfied unless it eats over 880 pounds of food every day. When it is done eating, it goes promptly to sleep.
cards.caption: What sounds like its cry may actually be its snores or the rumblings of its hungry belly.

cards.name: Articuno
cards.blurb: It’s said that this Pokémon’s beautiful blue wings are made of ice. Articuno flies over snowy mountains, its long tail fluttering along behind it.
cards.caption: One of the legendary bird Pokémon. With its long tail trailing behind, its flying form is magnificent.

cards.name: Zapdos
cards.blurb: This Pokémon has complete control over electricity. There are tales of Zapdos nesting in the dark depths of pitch-black thunderclouds.
cards.caption: One of the legendary bird Pokémon. While it is flying, it makes crackling and snapping sounds.

cards.name: Moltres
cards.blurb: It’s one of the legendary bird Pokémon. When Moltres flaps its flaming wings, they glimmer with a dazzling red glow.
cards.caption: One of the legendary bird Pokémon. Those seeing it are overwhelmed by its orange wings that seem to be on fire.

cards.name: Dragonite
cards.blurb: It’s a kindhearted Pokémon. If it spots a drowning person or Pokémon, Dragonite simply must help them.
cards.caption: It is said that somewhere in the ocean lies an island where these gather. Only they live there.

cards.name: Mewtwo
cards.blurb: It was created by a scientist after years of horrific gene-splicing and DNA-engineering experiments.
cards.caption: Said to rest quietly in an undiscovered cave, this Pokémon was created solely for battling.

cards.name: Tyranitar
cards.blurb: Its body can’t be harmed by any sort of attack, so it is very eager to make challenges against enemies.
cards.caption: If it rampages, it knocks down mountains and buries rivers. Maps must be redrawn afterward.

cards.name: Lucario
cards.blurb: It controls waves known as auras, which are powerful enough to pulverize huge rocks. It uses these waves to take down its prey.
cards.caption: It has the ability to sense the auras of all things. It understands human speech.
